newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound up slightly vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound up slightly vs dlr.

text.p: The Egyptian pound rose slightly against the dollar on Wednesday in a private sector market which was still quiet after Tuesday's bank holiday, bankers said.
The Central Bank and state-owned banks were closed on Tuesday to mark the beginning of the 1997/8 fiscal year.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3930 pounds and 3.3945 pounds bid and at between 3.3955 pounds and 3.3985 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average rate on Wednesday was 3.3937 pounds bid and 3.3962 pounds offered. These averages compare to 3.3943 pounds bid and 3.3964 pounds offered on Monday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.389279 buy and 3.397869 sell.
